validationLimits: Native Linux and Windows platform jobs were not run on this macOS host. Platform-dependent skips are not passes.
Authenticated Claude/Codex canaries were not run. Deterministic native SDK/RPC transports establish prompt wiring and storage behavior, not production model quality or latency.
Original incident attribution requires the affected project, run and installed version. Local wrong-ticket reproductions do not identify that historical incident.

Legacy migration conservatively quarantines observed QA instead of automatically treating historical progress as permission. The operator can link a proven approval/assignment/session chain or explicitly authorize inspected mapped work through audited repair.

Repair and migration publication boundaries use fault injection. Guidance intent/dispatch/receipt tests and existing handback suites also use actual child-process SIGKILL. Fault-injection coverage is not claimed as SIGKILL coverage at every repair boundary.

Storage tests exercise representative cross-run/scope/parent mutations and enumerate scope guards; they do not establish an exhaustive Cartesian product of every public method and every malformed field.

Repair preserves source. Branch separation or baseline restoration is an operator-inspected prerequisite where necessary; the host records the inspected mapping and attestation and requires fresh QA without replaying uncertain work.
Remote question wakeup uses bounded polling and cancellation of the obsolete prompt. There is no reliance on a separate local notification service.

The complete plan release exit gate remains pending native platform verification and release rehearsal on operator-approved copies of any actual affected build. No deployment, production migration or repair was performed.
regressionConclusion: No failures in final local workspace and installed-consumer validation. All five original findings and the approved after-pass policy are resolved; testing does not prove absence of every possible regression.

auditFollowup.plan: The reviewed five-finding fix plan in the conversation

findings.result: Quoted credentials, complete Authorization headers, overlap offsets, URL host/path preservation, escaped embedded JSON, rendered packets/chunks and protected raw bytes are covered.

Explicit resume dispatches waiting Builder guidance within existing admitted scope and remaining shared attempts, invalidates the old pass atomically, then requires fresh QA. Current-branch and isolated-worktree recovery share one service. Exhaustion supports one review-bound request_attempt; requirements changes require approval. Provider retry is disabled, completed proof is reused, and uncertain submissions remain fenced.

findings.status: resolved for eligible current-source failed reviews
findings.result: Restores the validated failed-review basis before replacing its attempt ID. Reconciles the accepted instruction, pending nonconvergence decision and unconsumed authorization atomically, separately from dispatch reservation. Answer races, restart, rollback, source drift, stale scope and uncertain execution remain explicit boundaries.

Completed metadata repairs stay terminal, waived work retains existing waiver policy, and eligible nonterminal repairs require fresh QA and invalidate old certificates. Immutable legacy receipts receive compatible interpretation; repeat repair cannot invalidate a fresh post-repair pass.

One-shot host output drains pinned pages and expands reports and oversized metadata with full redaction disclosures; expiry never silently refreshes. Identity-based raw export resolves the retained occurrence and discloses its digest.

auditFollowup.approvedPolicy: The user explicitly approved using existing authority and remaining attempts on explicit resume, with new authorization only when needed. Saving guidance alone never starts work.

scope: Original five audit findings and the manager QA/resume implementation plan
Scoped authority, renewed admissions, attempt accounting, atomic rollback and certificate invalidation
Current-branch and isolated-worktree recipient ordering, session preparation and source-bound fresh QA
Crash recovery, retained completion proof and provider retry fences

additionalFindings.finding: A guidance follow-up advanced only the in-memory remediation generation, so an ensuing failed QA review could not accept an authorized fix. Its intent now advances the durable reducer generation atomically, and fresh hosts recover that generation. Regression coverage resumes after the completed receipt, fails QA, then authorizes and completes the fix.
An applied attempt authorization could be retrieved after admission scope changed. Retrieval now binds requirements, assignment and scope revision; regression coverage exercises renewed admission.

One-shot expansion parsed rendered oversized metadata, which can be invalid JSON after secret redaction. Host expansion now uses the pinned already-sanitized structured item; secret-field regression coverage reproduces and verifies the fix.
